interviewPrep.companyOverview: Finly is a high-growth fintech infrastructure startup building low-latency multi-currency settlement rails and corporate treasury automation.

originalSubject: Interview Invitation: PhonePe Technical Screen (Round 1)
originalBody:
Hi Jayraj,

Hope this email finds you well. The team at PhonePe was very glad to review your engineering work. We would like to schedule a 60-minute technical screening call covering Core Java/Node.js, concurrency, and DB indexing on October 28, 2026 at 11:30 AM IST.

Let us know if you are available.

interviewPrep.companyOverview: PhonePe is India's premier digital payments UPI super-app processing over 6 billion monthly transactions with ultra-high concurrency demands.
interviewPrep.roleSummary: Technical Screen focusing on thread concurrency, lock-free data structures, connection pooling, and distributed database sharding.
topicsToPrepare: Java Memory Model / Node.js Event Loop Microtasks vs Macrotasks
Optimistic vs Pessimistic Locking under heavy contention
B-Tree vs LSM Tree storage engines in high-write workloads
Handling network timeouts and reverse-charge transactions

expectedQuestions.question: How do you avoid deadlock when two concurrent payment transactions update reciprocal accounts?
expectedQuestions.sampleApproach: Always acquire locks in a globally deterministic order (e.g. by sorting account IDs lexicographically before lock acquisition) or use timeout-based lock retries.

questionsToAskInterviewer: How does the platform handle UPI bank gateway downtimes during National Festival peak surges?
What does the canary deployment process look like for core settlement services?
